name: Lower Deck
address: 601 S Harbour Island Blvd Ste 110, Tampa, FL 33602
one_liner: Laid-back dockside waterfront bar at the marina level of Harbour Island with panoramic Tampa skyline views, raw oysters, craft cocktails, and live music; the casual coastal escape just below American Social.

name: American Social
address: 601 S Harbour Island Blvd #107, Tampa, FL 33602
one_liner: Spacious waterfront bar-and-kitchen on Harbour Island with Tampa skyline views, indoor/outdoor bars, Taco Tuesday, and weekend nightlife energy; lively, stylish, busy, loud, and fun.

name: Boulon
one_liner: Bright all-day French brasserie and bakery in Water Street serving beef tartare, lobster bisque, and burlesque martinis; lively, attentive, and stylish, a special-occasion spot.

name: Predalina
one_liner: Glamorous Mediterranean coastal restaurant and after-dark cocktail lounge on Water Street, all hand-laid mosaics, olive trees, and a gold disco ball over a painted dance floor.

name: 511 Franklin
one_liner: Upscale-casual downtown craft cocktail bar with a strong bourbon selection, well-made old fashioneds, happy-hour specials, and DJ nights; classy yet welcoming, drawing a 23+ after-dark professional crowd.

name: Echo Downtown
one_liner: Downtown Franklin St late-night dance club spinning R&B and Latin on weekends only with cover charges; energetic crowd and music.

name: Delta Downtown
one_liner: Multi-floor downtown nightclub running three zones of music, EDM/house outdoors, hip-hop on the first floor, Spanish upstairs, open Friday and Saturday nights with cover charges; vibrant and danceable.

name: M.Bird
one_liner: Rooftop American restaurant and bar atop Armature Works with sweeping Tampa Bay views, friendly attentive staff, a DJ-driven night scene, and solid food; a lively special-occasion and celebration spot, busy on weekends.

name: Armature Works
one_liner: Historic 1910 streetcar warehouse turned Tampa Heights food hall and riverside entertainment destination, family-friendly by day and a nightlife hub by night, with M.Bird on the roof.

name: Sunset Rodeo
one_liner: Nashville-inspired SoHo live-music bar with weekly country and Southern-rock acts, standout decor, an outdoor patio, brunch, VIP tables, and a 23+ policy; high-energy with Nashville hot chicken and smash burgers.

name: The Grove
one_liner: SoHo bar with DJs, live reggae, well-made bar drinks, and excellent outdoor service; clean, entertaining, and friendly.

name: MacDinton's
one_liner: SoHo's biggest Irish pub and nightlife institution with multiple bars, DJs, karaoke, trivia, daily specials, and a sports patio; high-energy college-adjacent crowd.

name: Corner Bar
one_liner: Chill, dog-friendly SoHo corner bar with weekend DJs, Tuesday karaoke and trivia, cigar-friendly outdoor seating, and Sunday $5 drink specials; great service and reasonable prices in a relaxed neighborhood vibe.

name: The Patio
one_liner: Easygoing multi-level SoHo patio bar and Bills Backers spot with three bars, a food truck, darts, plenty of TVs, and reasonable prices; chill, electric on game days, with limited parking.

name: Meat Market
one_liner: Upscale Hyde Park steakhouse with prime cuts, sushi, lobster mac, and craft cocktails in a trendy, elegant indoor-outdoor setting; a popular special-occasion destination.

name: The Blind Goat
one_liner: Lively, dog-friendly South Tampa bar-and-grill with elevated bar food, pizzas, wings, the Goat Drip cocktail, dart boards, pool, and weekly trivia and bingo; loud, younger FSU-leaning crowd, owner-run feel.

name: Red Dog
address: 3311 W Bay to Bay Blvd, Tampa, FL 33629
one_liner: Casual neighborhood bar with billiards, darts, cold beer, strong drinks, and good burgers; friendly local vibe and a unique atmosphere.

name: Dead Bob's
one_liner: Unpretentious, budget-friendly South Tampa fisherman's sports bar, open 11am-3am daily, packed with TVs and serving standout burgers, wings, French dips, and mahi bites; lively, friendly, and beloved by locals.

name: Five Bucks Drinkery
one_liner: Busy Central Ave sports bar and grill open 11am-3am daily with sidewalk seating, value-priced food and drinks, famous fries, and fast friendly bartenders; reliable lunch and late-night downtown staple.

name: Banana Hammock
one_liner: Laid-back outdoor bar tucked behind Five Bucks with cheap $5 cans, a smoky 'illegal margarita,' wings, fries, and French dips; relaxed street-side seating and music away from the noise.

name: The Canopy at the Birchwood
address: 340 Beach Dr NE, St. Petersburg, FL 33701
one_liner: Rooftop bar atop the Birchwood with panoramic Old Tampa Bay and downtown views, excellent espresso martinis, and prime sunset timing; elegant and festive.

name: Cane & Barrel
one_liner: Relaxed rooftop bar atop the AC Marriott with two full bars, Latin-Caribbean tapas, empanadas, yuca fries, peekaboo bay views, and DJ or steel-drum nights; calm hidden-gem ambiance.

name: Copper Shaker
one_liner: Speakeasy-style craft cocktail bar with a premium whiskey selection, hand-crafted old fashioneds, truffle fries, and Taco Tuesday; bartenders who remember your name, classy and chill, open till 3am nightly.

name: Crafty Squirrel
one_liner: Versatile Central Ave spot that's a cozy sports pub by day and a late-night dance bar by night, with two-for-one happy hours, bottomless mimosas, bottle service, and a flavor-forward new menu.

name: Ferg's Sports Bar
one_liner: Sprawling, nationally top-rated sports bar near Tropicana Field with hundreds of TVs, $5 game-day beers, famous wings, live music, two dog parks, and a tunnel toward the Trop.

name: Flute & Dram
address: 234 Beach Dr NE, St. Petersburg, FL 33701
one_liner: Polished Beach Drive whiskey-and-champagne lounge with cigars, caviar, an in-house humidor, 25%-off-whiskey Thursdays, live music, and prime waterfront people-watching; one of the best-located bars on the strip.

name: Good Night John Boy
one_liner: High-energy 1970s disco-themed dance bar with a checkerboard dance floor, retro decor, and a mix of 70s hits and newer beats; reasonably priced, all-ages-of-adult fun, extremely packed after 9pm.

name: Jannus Live
address: 200 1st Ave N Ste 206, St. Petersburg, FL 33701
one_liner: Intimate historic open-air courtyard concert venue hosting surprisingly big touring acts with great acoustics, no bad sightlines, a balcony, and multiple bars; minimal seating, standing-room shows.

name: Mandarin Hide
one_liner: Rustic, dimly lit craft cocktail lounge known for expertly built old fashioneds and the best spicy margarita around, with vintage decor, live music, and $9 weeknight specials; conversational until late, open till 3am.

name: Mary Margaret's
one_liner: Authentic downtown Irish pub with flawless Guinness pours, full Irish breakfast, banger-and-mash, and mustard-slaw sandwiches; lively daily with a sharp bar staff, open till 2-2:30am.

name: My Rich Uncle
one_liner: Weekend-only high-energy nightclub-style bar open Friday-Saturday 8pm-2:30am with thumping DJ sets, bottle service, and dedicated VIP hosts; cinematic party atmosphere with a dressed-up crowd.

name: Oak & Stone
one_liner: Casual craft-pizza restaurant with a signature self-pour beer wall, tons of taps, gluten-free options, and sports on TV; affordable, relaxed, and walkable to the St. Pete Pier.

name: The One Night Stand
one_liner: Comfortably worn-in country dive bar centered on a mechanical bull, with country music, a 25% military discount, and a welcoming community spirit; open till 3am.

name: Park & Rec DTSP
one_liner: Big playful gastro-bar and adult arcade with pool, games, cornhole, a wall of TVs, self-poured bottomless mimosas, $25 all-you-can-eat snacks, free trivia, and a dog-friendly, game-day-friendly vibe.

name: Pier Teaki
address: 800 2nd Ave NE 5th Floor, St. Petersburg, FL 33701
one_liner: Open-air rooftop tiki bar atop the St. Pete Pier with sweeping water, city, and dolphin views, creative tiki cocktails, and shareable plates like lobster-chorizo empanadas; chill tropical mood.

name: Pour Judgement
one_liner: Central Ave bar built around an extensive menu-book of shots and themed drink specials, with engaging bartenders and fun start-the-night energy, open till 3am.

name: Saigon Blonde
one_liner: Funky Vietnam/New Orleans-themed lounge on the Central Ave drag with eclectic war-era decor, house and techno DJs, rum old fashioneds, hemp cocktails, and THC seltzers; chill early, lively and danceable late.

name: Sparrow
one_liner: Rooftop Asian-leaning restaurant and cocktail bar atop the Moxy with views toward Tropicana Field, pork bao buns, sushi, lobster mac, and tequila-espresso martinis; stylish weekend energy.

name: Tequila Daisy
one_liner: Compact downtown tequila bar boasting one of the world's largest tequila collections, custom-built cocktails, hibiscus palomas, and guided tastings; friendly fast-paced bartenders and a great meet-up size, open till 3am.

name: The Landing
one_liner: Loft bar above Jannus Live with great city views, local DJ events, a full bar, and Sunday-Funday shot specials; cool hideaway vibe.

name: Trailer Daddy
one_liner: Tongue-in-cheek trailer-park-themed bar with creative cocktails, playful shots like the American Pie and PB&J, and cheesesteaks; great music, genuine staff, and a fresh, lively concept, open weekends till 2am.

name: Tryst
address: 240 Beach Dr NE, St. Petersburg, FL 33701
one_liner: Eclectic Beach Drive gastro-lounge with a Mediterranean-French menu, fish tacos, bottomless mimosas, hookah, Tito's on tap, and live music; prime patio people-watching and fast service, open till 3am.

name: Detroit 201
one_liner: Tiny Central Ave corner cocktail bar with nightly live music, a string-lit patio, an abundant drink list, $5 old fashioneds, and barrel-aged ales; intimate, vibey, with a lovely on-site owner.

name: Welcome To The Farm
one_liner: Popular downtown country bar with live country music, weekend outdoor DJs, multiple bars, Thursday karaoke, free military entry, and a late-night sports-bar connection; a local home base.
